title: Obituary Retrieval Backlog
dataSources: Hints (`genealogy:hint`), cemetery visits (`genealogy:cemetery`), family-photo work (`genealogy:photo`), research ops (`genealogy:ops`).
app: Genealogy and family-history telemetry — Ancestry hints, cemetery visit logs, and photo-restoration queues — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=genealogy:ops newspaper_title=* retrieval_state=*
| stats sum(eval(if(retrieval_state!="done",1,0))) as backlog, count as total by newspaper_title
| where backlog>0
| sort - backlog
description: Lists pending obituary requests backlog by newspaper for document retrieval.
value: Backlog counts expose where small unfinished tasks accumulate and create hidden drag inside document retrieval.
implementation: Mark each `genealogy:ops` record with a pending-state flag and summarize backlog totals by `newspaper_title`.
visualization: Table of newspaper with pending obituary requests counts.
grandmaExplanation: It blends where unfinished obituary requests are piling up so you can clear the biggest queues in document retrieval.
